```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileFlow common) => {
    
    /*** creating IMobileBlock 'Header' ***/
    var header = common.CreateBlock("Header");
    header.Description = null; // default value
    header.Public = false; // default value
    var eSpace = common.GetESpace();
    
    var clicked = header.CreateEvent("Clicked");
    clicked.IsMandatory = false;
    
    var onHeaderClick = header.CreateScreenAction("OnHeaderClick");
    
    var startNode = onHeaderClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    
    var toggleMenu = onHeaderClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("ToggleMenu");
    var toggleMenu2 = eSpace.ClientActions.Named("ToggleMenu");
    toggleMenu.Action = toggleMenu2;
    startNode.Target = toggleMenu;
    
    var endNode = onHeaderClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    toggleMenu.Target = endNode;
    
    var container = header.CreateWidget<ServiceStudio.Plugin.NRWidgets.IContainer>();
    container.SetStyle("\"demo-header\"");
    var event1 = container.CreateEvent();
    event1.Event = "onclick";
    event1.Handler = onHeaderClick;
}
```
